title: Musk Releases a Big Move! SpaceX AI Team Will Broadcast for Three Consecutive Days, Using Grok Bot to Build a Tech Company from Scratch
excerpt: Elon Musk's SpaceX AI team has officially announced that they will hold a three-day live broadcast from September 15 to 17, local time. Unlike regular technical
content_html:
Elon Musk's SpaceX AI team has officially announced that they will hold a three-day live broadcast from September 15 to 17, local time. Unlike regular technical demonstrations, this event will focus on real-world challenges, comprehensively demonstrating how the team, using only Grok Bot and a blank sheet of paper, starts from scratch to come up with creative ideas, develop business plans, finalize product features, and gradually advance actual engineering work, ultimately transforming an abstract concept into a real operational business.

According to the official schedule, the live broadcast will take place daily from 8:30 AM to 6:00 PM. The team will provide a realistic, modular demonstration of the specific workflow of Grok Bot in various stages of enterprise operations.

In terms of agenda progression, the event is divided into three days, gradually delving deeper. The first day, September 15, will mainly cover the introduction to Grok Bot, underlying engineering development, as well as special sessions for product managers and founders, focusing on deconstructing the concept and architectural design of early projects. On September 16, the focus will shift to the core aspects of commercial implementation, highlighting key functions such as sales engineering, sales teams, sales development representatives (SDRs), and customer support. The final day, September 17, will focus on marketing operations, after-sales systems, and related marketing topics, providing a comprehensive view of Grok Bot's role in the back-end operations of enterprises.

Through this three-day immersive live broadcast, the SpaceX AI team will intuitively reveal how Grok Bot deeply participates in every practical aspect, from writing the first line of code to helping customers succeed, and share specific and detailed application cases for different job positions, offering a highly referenceable practical example for the deep integration of AI in the industrial sector.
